title: Password reset via email link
acceptance_criteria:
User Story: Reset a forgotten password

Acceptance Criteria:
- User can request a reset link by entering their registered email
- The same confirmation message is shown whether or not the email is registered
- The reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent
- A reset link can only be used once
- New password must be at least 10 characters and include a number
- New password cannot be the same as the current password
- After a successful reset, all other active sessions are logged out

expected_scenarios.description: Registered email receives a reset link and user sets a valid new password
Unregistered email shows the same confirmation message (no account enumeration)
Link used just before 30 minutes works
Link used after 30 minutes is rejected
Reusing an already-used link is rejected
Password of exactly 10 characters with a number is accepted (boundary)
Password of 9 characters, or without a number, is rejected
New password equal to the current password is rejected
Other active sessions are logged out after reset
Tampered or malformed reset token is rejected
